title: Lower bounds for the critical CR GJMS operator
summary: We establish lower bounds for the critical CR GJMS operator on closed pseudo-Hermitian manifolds. In dimension $2n+1$, assuming embeddability, we obtain a lower bound involving the Heisenberg Sobolev norm of order $n+1$, modulo an $L^{2}$ term, on the orthogonal complement of the kernel. In dimension three, we prove that the CR Paneitz operator is bounded below without assuming embeddability.
